title: Evidence Admission R1
question: Why was Evidence Admission R1 enforcement not retained?
short_answer: Evidence Admission R1 enforcement was not retained because the formal HTTP evaluation failed the preregistered primary non-inferiority criterion. R0 shadow and gate-off controls preserved served retrieval output, but R1 enforcement lost one required-lineage coverage case versus normal retrieval.
